claim.claim-text: patterning a laser beam using a mirror array; and reflecting the patterned laser beam from the mirror array onto a powder to melt the powder, wherein the pattern corresponds to a portion of a layer of an article.

2. A method according to claim 1, further comprising: providing a desired distribution profile to the laser beam; optionally further comprising controlling an energy intensity of the patterned beam through changes of a reflection angle of each mirror.

3. A method according to claim 1, wherein the patterned laser beam comprises a plurality of laser spots, and groups of 9-25 mirrors are configured to provide each laser spot of the patterned laser beam; wherein optionally a power capacity of each mirror is 1 to 3 watts and the groups of mirrors are configured to provide laser spots of 10 to 25 watts; wherein each laser spot is preferably 0.1 mm.
4. A method according to claim 1, wherein the pattern corresponds to a 10% to 100% of the layer of the article.
5. A method according to claim 1, wherein 1600 to 4000 spots are illuminated simultaneously, particularly in an array of 200 x 200 mirrors.
6. A method according to claim 1, wherein the patterned laser beam comprises beams of different frequencies or wavelengths.
7. A method according to claim 1, wherein the build is made with a series of laser pulses enabling a parallel operation.
8. A method according to claim 1, further comprising implementing a waterfall type powder delivery in which powder is falling in a thin sheet in front of a horizontally built part.

10. A system according to claim 9, further comprising: an optical system configured to provide a desired distribution profile to the laser beam; wherein the optical system is particularly further configured to control an energy intensity of the patterned beam through changes of a reflection angle of each mirror.

11. A system according to claim 9, wherein the patterned laser beam comprises a plurality of laser spots, and groups of 9-25 mirrors are configured to provide each laser spot of the patterned laser beam; wherein optionally a power capacity of each mirror is 1 to 3 watts and the groups of mirrors are configured to provide laser spots of 10 to 25 watts; wherein each laser spot is particularly 0.1 mm.
12. A system according to claim 9, wherein the pattern corresponds to a 10% to 100% of the layer of the article.
13. A system according to claim 9, wherein the mirror array is configured to illuminate 1600 to 4000 spots simultaneously, particularly in an array of 200 x 200.
14. A system according to claim 9, wherein the patterned laser beam comprises beams of different frequencies or wavelengths.
15. A system according to claim 9, wherein the system is configured to make a build with a series of laser pulses enabling a parallel operation.
